card: This PR adds a new REST endpoint at /rest/txspendingprevout/ that mirrors the gettxspendingprevout RPC. Clients querying the node via the unauthenticated HTTP REST API previously had no way to look up transactions spending specific outpoints in the mempool or txospenderindex without falling back to JSON-RPC. The endpoint supports batch queries of up to 15 outpoints and includes mempool_only and return_spending_tx query parameters. This completes REST coverage tracked under issue 33808 following the merge of PR 24539.
evidence: Follows up on the introduction and extensions of the `gettxspendingprevout` RPC (PR #24539) as part of issue #33808 to achieve REST feature parity.
problem: Users and external applications using the unauthenticated HTTP REST interface cannot query which transactions spend given outpoints, requiring them to use JSON-RPC instead even though the node already supports outpoint spend indexing.
summary: Adds a REST endpoint `/rest/txspendingprevout/` that exposes the functionality of the `gettxspendingprevout` RPC. The endpoint accepts up to 15 outpoints in the URI and queries the mempool or the optional `txospenderindex` to identify spending transactions. It supports JSON output format along with `mempool_only` and `return_spending_tx` boolean query parameters.
